TASK. List every RIVALRY and every ALLIANCE that genuinely existed in January 1946.

HARD RULES:
1. Use ONLY ids from the roster. Never ISO codes, never invented ids.
2. Each pair exactly once (a<b alphabetically). No duplicates, no mirrored repeats.
3. A dependent entity has no foreign policy of its own - EXCEPT when it acted on its own in 1946 (disputed administrations, contested republics, occupation zones facing each other).
4. "why" must name the concrete fact: a treaty with its year, a war, a crisis, a claim. Not a vague label.
5. State of the world in JANUARY 1946 only. Do NOT include what started later (no NATO, no Warsaw Pact, no Korean War, no Israel).

COVERAGE. Be exhaustive, not illustrative. Work through these axes before answering, and do not stop early: the emerging Soviet-Western split; the Iran crisis; the Greek civil war and its neighbours; the Chinese civil war; colonial wars of independence (Indochina, Indonesia); the Arab world and the Palestine question; Indian subcontinent tensions; Latin American regional rivalries; Balkan and Danubian disputes; Soviet claims on Turkey; occupation zones in Germany, Austria, Korea; Commonwealth and inter-American systems; Soviet bilateral treaties of 1943-1945; unresolved border claims left by the war.

Expect substantially more than 30 rivalry pairs and more than 30 alliance pairs if you are being thorough.

Answer with JSON ONLY, no prose, no markdown fence:
{"rivalries":[{"a":"XXX","b":"YYY","why":"..."}],"alliances":[{"a":"XXX","b":"YYY","why":"..."}]}
